returnContent.description: Whether to return the explicitly selected compact row page directly in the tool response. May be combined with output.

limit.description: Maximum number of table rows requested in this response page. The provider may return fewer to keep the machine response bounded.

offset.description: Zero-based row offset. Continue only when an unreturned row is needed for the current operation; unused blank template rows need not be read.

output.description: Optional path for retaining the selected detailed row page. May be combined with returnContent.
